'''Fernando Walls''' (6 February 1931 &ndash; 28 April 2005) was a Mexican chemist and [[Shooting sport|sports shooter]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iquimica.unam.mx/homenajewalls.html|title=Publicaciones del Instituto de Química|date=11 May 2006|accessdate=23 June 2017|url-status=bot: unknown|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20060511024846/http://www.iquimica.unam.mx/homenajewalls.html|archivedate=11 May 2006|df=dmy-all}}</ref> He competed at the [[1972 Summer Olympics]] and the [[1976 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/wa/fernando-walls-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418055844/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/wa/fernando-walls-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=David Alkon |accessdate=24 February 2016 |work=Sports Reference}}</ref>
